Candidate 1 (C381): LOGARITHMIC MOTIVES, VOEVODSKY MOTIVIC SPECTRA AND WEIGHT FILTRATIONS
Claim 1: Binda-Park-Ostvaer logarithmic motivic spectra and Voevodsky slice filtrations isolate Diophantine integer points from rational boundary points.
Method 1: Logarithmic motives, motivic homotopy categories DM_log(k), and motivic cohomology of log schemes.

Candidate 2 (C384): RELATIVE DERIVED MODULI OF LOCAL SYSTEMS AND CHARACTER VARIETIES OVER SPEC Z
Claim 2: Relative derived character varieties RMap(pi_1(P^1 \ {0, 1, inf}), GL_n) over Spec Z impose non-trivial obstruction classes forbidding Beal solutions.
Method 2: Relative derived algebraic geometry, representation varieties, and schematization of homotopy types.
